title: Distill support-derived function vectors into a rank-four shared Mirror decoder
hypothesis: For held-out tasks in pinned Pythia-70m, a rank-four shared linear decoder trained by FV reconstruction on task IDs 0-11 and held-out task codes fit to their FV teacher targets will preserve causal held-out task effect within 0.10 mean gold-logprob nats and 0.05 accuracy of explicit FVs, use <=0.50x explicit FV-bank bytes, and beat native rank-four PCA by >=0.10 gold-logprob nats in both development seeds.
physical_object: Frozen EleutherAI/pythia-70m-deduped at revision e93a9faa9c77e5d09219f6c868bfc7a1bd65593c; support-derived layer-4 task FVs for sixteen relation tasks.
mirror_coordinate: One four-scalar code per relation task decoded by a learned shared mean-plus-linear basis trained with FV teacher reconstruction loss.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen relation functions represented by one shared decoder and sixteen compact codes, with tasks 12-15 withheld from decoder fitting.
controls: Explicit int8 FV bank with per-vector scale
Native centered PCA rank-four basis fit to task IDs 0-11, with held-out codes by least squares
Mirror rank-four learned shared linear decoder trained on task IDs 0-11

task.shared_extractor: MA-516 frozen function-vector extraction implementation, support split and evaluator
task.candidate_set: all distinct held-out target strings for each task
task.primary_metric: mean held-out gold candidate log probability across task IDs 12-15

distillation.decoder: v_hat = mean_train + W m, where W is 512x4 and each function address m has four FP32 scalars
distillation.training_targets: the twelve extracted task FV teachers for IDs 0-11
distillation.loss: mean squared error over all 512 dimensions and 12 task vectors
distillation.optimizer: Adam, full-batch, learning rate 0.01, zero weight decay, exactly 2000 updates
distillation.initialization: NumPy and Torch RNG seeded by the registered development seed; W and training codes iid Normal(0, 1/sqrt(512))
distillation.heldout_code_assignment: least-squares projection of each held-out teacher FV onto the frozen learned decoder; teacher vectors are discarded after code serialization
distillation.selection: no hyperparameter or seed selection; one frozen rank and fixed update count

fresh.opening_rule: Open only if both dev seeds preserve held-out causal quality within the explicit-FV tolerances, beat native PCA by >=0.10 mean gold-logprob nats, and fit <=0.50x explicit FV bytes.

paid_objects: int8 per-vector scales for quantized control
storage.common_base: Include pinned model/config/tokenizer actual bytes in total deployment; common across methods. No task FV or reconstructed vector is cached.

compute.hardware: CPU, fixed five-thread limit, no GPU
compute.active_compute_proxy: report FV training multiplies (2000*12*512*4), held-out code projection multiplies (4*512*4), and intervention-vector adds per scored candidate sequence
compute.wall_clock: separately report extraction, fitting, code assignment, and query evaluation

gates.PASS: In both dev seeds: <=0.05 absolute held-out top-1 drop and <=0.10 nat mean gold-logprob drop from explicit FVs; <=0.50x explicit FP32 bank bytes; and >=0.10 nat mean gold-logprob improvement over native PCA rank-four at matched rank and comparable bytes.
gates.FAIL: Any frozen quality or byte gate is missed, or learned decoder does not beat native PCA by the registered margin in both seeds.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Pinned artifact integrity, task split alignment, or deterministic result replay fails.

boundaries: Sixteen constrained relation tasks and four decoder-held-out tasks on one 70M model; not broad reasoning or open-ended generation.
FV teacher targets are used to assign held-out codes, and their acquisition cost is reported; only codes and decoder are inference state.
A low-rank learned decoder is also a standard low-rank shared basis; native PCA is the attribution control.
Fresh seeds remain unopened unless all frozen quality, byte, and attribution gates pass.
